items.copyText:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

SeaDays Launches Next-Generation Cruise Planning App for Android and iOS

Hamburg, Germany — November 1, 2025 — SeaDays, a Hamburg-based travel technology company, today announced the launch of its cruise planning and travel companion app for Android and iOS.

SeaDays brings intelligent itinerary tools, ship and port discovery, social crew features, and offline-ready planning to cruisers worldwide. The app is designed to help travelers organize voyages, track ships and ports, connect with fellow cruisers, and manage cruise planning in one polished mobile experience.

SeaDays is available on Google Play and the App Store.

Website: https://seadays.app
Media contact: press@seadays.app
